messages:
hema: Heads-up 8: new all-hands Friday 9:00am PT. Title: 'Strategy checkpoint + launch takeaways'. Run ~40m: 8m company context, 12m launch metrics & short RCA, 8m customer stories, 7m infra ops & mitigations, 5m open Q&A. Drop any must-cover bullets by Wed noon.

oliver: Invite is live: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3130001234>. Please RSVP.

rachael: For customer stories, please send a 1-line blurb + contact (opt-in) by Thu EOD. We'll pick three.

darius: Ops will summarize the weekend failover event in 3 bullets and include the follow-up checklist. Will post the one-pager here Thurs AM.

claire: Accessibility: captions ON; transcript attached after. If you need interpreter services reply: "interpretation: yes". Also note: we'll include a short summary slide with "what we want teams to do" for each section.

hema: Q intake: drop Qs here or use the form <https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-qa>. Mark LIVE at start if you want to ask on-air.

oliver: Presenters please upload slides to the shared deck by Thu 5pm: <https://drive.redwood.com/allhands/strategy>. Ping me for upload rights.

rachael: LIVE: will we adjust the rollout timing for international regions after the routing incident?

darius: LIVE answer: yes we'll add a short staged delay and enable extra monitoring for APAC; details on the mitigation slide.

allhands-bot: Reminders set: 48h, 2h, 10m before start. Recording + transcript posted to #all-hands-resources after meeting. :loudspeaker:

hema: Action items: 1) Presenters upload slides Thu 5pm (owners: product, infra, support). 2) Darius post incident one-pager Thu AM. 3) Rachael collect customer blurb by Thu EOD. 4) Claire collect interpretation needs by Wed noon. I'll publish the final agenda Thu evening. Thanks everyone! :star:
